title: ReportToxicity
description: A moderation and reporting plugin for Minecraft servers that sends reports to the ReportToxicity platform and can also alert server owners or admins through Discord when configured.
body:
# ReportToxicity

A Minecraft moderation operations plugin for servers that want more than a basic `/report` command.

ReportToxicity gives players a guided reporting flow and gives staff a clean in game workspace for reviewing reports, checking offender history, leaving notes, managing priorities, and taking action without turning moderation into chat clutter.

Reports are saved locally first and synced in the background to the ReportToxicity platform, so your server can keep accepting reports even if the backend is temporarily unavailable.

## Key Features

### Guided Player Reporting
- Multi step GUI reporting flow
- Category selection
- Reason entry
- Optional evidence URLs
- Confirmation before submit
- `/report <player>` shortcut

### In Game Staff Workflow
- Staff inbox with `/rt reports`
- Filter and review reports in game
- Claim, accept, decline, archive, and punish
- Review notes and priority controls
- Offender history and related report bundles
- Cleaner moderation flow without relying on chat spam

### Reliability
- Queue first delivery
- Local SQLite storage
- Background sync worker
- Retry handling during backend outages
- Local archive support
- Better queue visibility and diagnostics

### Anti Abuse Protections
- Cooldown enforcement
- Duplicate detection
- Self report blocking
- Minimum playtime checks
- Reporter trust gate support

## Why Use It

Most report plugins stop at submission.

ReportToxicity is built around the full moderation workflow. It helps staff process reports faster, keep context around repeat offenders, and sync moderation activity to a larger platform instead of leaving everything isolated inside one server.

## Compatibility
- Paper / Spigot 1.21.x through 26.1.x
- Java 21
- One jar

## Main Commands
- `/rt report`
- `/report <player>`
- `/rt reports`
- `/rt history <player>`
- `/rt stats`
- `/rt bundles`
- `/rt status`
- `/rt queue`
- `/rt reload`
- `/rt help`
- `/rt help staff`

## Permissions
- `reporttoxicity.*`
- `reporttoxicity.report`
- `reporttoxicity.status`
- `reporttoxicity.staff`
- `reporttoxicity.admin`

## Installation
1. Download the plugin jar
2. Place it in your `plugins` folder
3. Start or restart the server
4. Run `/rt setup`
5. Link your server to ReportToxicity
6. Test reporting and staff access in game

## Notes
- An active ReportToxicity subscription is required
- No extra plugin dependency is required
- Built for server owners and moderation teams who want a more structured and scalable way to handle reports
